g.text: Phase 17 Code-to-Spec Coverage + Phase 18 Test-Mapping Accelerator
Pending and rejected proposals are quarantined.
They do not feed catalog, coverage, debt retirement,
Coverage, names, paths, and mutation kills are not semantic proof.
Each assertion is bound to exact oracle behavior rows;
high-risk mappings require two distinct reviewers.
Profiles close package, target, binary, and module-prefix identity.
The browser-analysis profile executes native Rust facade tests only;
it does not claim wasm32, JavaScript, or rendered-browser proof.
Module imports are retained even for wrapper modules with no functions.
Private sibling imports and private targets do not leak, cycles terminate,
and multiple qualified helper targets remain ambiguous rather than proof.
Focused pilot and implementation shards reconstruct only requested
reviewed source files and fail on stale identity. They do not rerun
the whole-repository test scanner. The scanner remains authoritative
for the single final denominator campaign.
This plane has no write edge into the accepted map.
Reported facts stay untrusted until live reconstruction.
It cannot infer bindings, close gaps, promote proof,
or refresh digests without an explicit reviewed transaction.
Code coverage cannot promote product proof,
close a specification gap, or replace rendered UI evidence.
registered_backlog remains unresolved for exact fact bindings
but is excluded from planner area expansion.
